descricao.pt: Tradução automática de tarefas do GLUE e do SuperGLUE para o português europeu e o do Brasil (14 tarefas de compreensão de linguagem).
descricao.en: Automatic translation of GLUE and SuperGLUE tasks into European and Brazilian Portuguese (14 language understanding tasks).

fonte.trecho: PORTULAN CLARIN—Research Infrastructure for the Science and Technology of Language

fontes.trecho: ExtraGLUE is a Portuguese dataset obtained by the automatic translation of some of the tasks in the GLUE and SuperGLUE benchmarks.
